messages:
rachel: Opening a tiny PR to tidy the 'hello-world' quickstart: clarify auth (.env vs inline), switch Dockerfile to multi-stage, and add a GH Actions secret example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4999
omar: Nice. Can you include a one-liner for local env export and a minimal .env example? New hires copy creds all the time.
rachel: Yep. Added `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` and a .env example with DO NOT COMMIT note. Also replaced inline token usage in snippets with `os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY']`.
omar: Make sure the code uses `client.generate()` (current SDK pattern). Don't reintroduce old auth wrappers.
rachel: Confirmed `client.generate()` used. I ran a quick smoke with a mock client.
ci-bot: Running link-check and secret-scan... link-check OK, secret-scan OK (no tokens detected).
docsbot: Small suggestion: add a one-line CI snippet: `echo "$REDWOOD_API_KEY" | gh secret set REDWOOD_API_KEY` and a 3-line GitHub Actions workflow referencing the quickstart.
rachel: Added CI snippet and a short macOS Docker networking troubleshooting note. Will merge once CI is green. Ping here for any follow-ups. :rocket:
